rules.instruction: Maintain workflows in .github/workflows/. Use reusable workflows. Cache dependencies.
Keep compose files DRY. Use environment variables. Document service dependencies.
Optimize nginx config. Enable SSL. Configure caching headers. Set up proper proxying.
Configure application logs. Set up metrics collection. Create dashboards. Define alerts.
Use .env files for local dev. Use secrets in CI/CD. Document required variables.
Never commit secrets. Use GitHub secrets. Rotate credentials regularly. Use secret scanning.
Parallelize jobs. Cache build artifacts. Use matrix builds. Minimize CI time.
Use rolling updates. Health check before switching. Have rollback plan.
